name: background_release_with_star_prefix
args: * I hereby grant permission to any person, firm or corporation to release to the Company or its representatives any and all information regarding my past work or employment. I waive any and all claims.
spec: "background_release": the person grants permission to any person, firm or corporation to release information regarding past work / employment to the Company (and waives claims).

name: background_release_plain
args: I hereby grant permission to any person, firm or corporation to release to the Company or its representatives any and all information regarding my past work or employment. I waive any and all claims.

name: at_will_with_star_prefix
args: * I understand that nothing contained in the application or in any interview is intended to create an employment contract, and that my employment would be on an at-will basis.
spec: "at_will": the person understands that employment, if hired, is on an at-will basis and nothing in the application or an interview creates an employment contract.

name: i9_verify_with_star_prefix
